name: toshipon-tools
description: toshipon 個人用の Claude Code プラグイン集。playbook 駆動の作業モードとそのサブ skill、読み取り専用の SRE harness を配布する。

plugins.name: toshipon-mode
plugins.description: Playbook-driven working mode for non-trivial tasks: verbatim playbook todolists, engineering principles, evidence-gated completion, plus the how/why/unslop/technical-writing/arena/interrogate skill set it routes to.

plugins.name: sre-harness
plugins.description: Read-only harnesses for review learning and specification consistency: structured lessons from GitHub review history, decision and requirement traceability across open pull requests, and an evidence contract for IaC delivery.
